=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:280-291 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `orchestrate_state_v2.py` is missing from the staged support-script allowlist.
  WHY: consumer repos only stage the explicitly listed scripts, so the V2 pack/extract calls fail with a missing file and state persistence/extraction breaks.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:195-198 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `orchestrate_state_v2.py` is missing from the first staging allowlist in this workflow.
  WHY: the staged support files do not include the V2 helper, so any shared path that calls it in consumer repos will fail at runtime.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:326-330 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `orchestrate_state_v2.py` is missing from the second staging allowlist in this workflow.
  WHY: the same runtime failure applies on this stage as well, because the V2 helper is not copied into the consumer repo support directory.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1039-1081 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment()` drops the old V1 write path and returns 0 on every V2 failure branch, so persistence can fail silently without writing anything.
  WHY: reviewers noted that the function logs `::error::` but still fails open; one reviewer additionally flagged the missing V1 fallback, while others flagged the silent success return.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1057-1060 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `2>&1` merges stderr into the JSON manifest capture.
  WHY: any helper warnings or tracebacks can contaminate `manifest_json` and break downstream jq parsing; one reviewer called this hardening, but others rated it medium/high/critical.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:147-158 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: the timeline API safety check calls `gh api` directly instead of `gh_retry gh api`.
  WHY: a transient GitHub API failure can make the fail-open lookup miss an existing PR and widen the race window; reviewers disagreed on whether the existing `|| true` makes this acceptable.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2891-2901 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: the later timeline API lookup also calls `gh api` directly instead of `gh_retry gh api`.
  WHY: the same transient-failure/race-window concern applies here as well, and reviewers disagreed on whether the fail-open contract is enough.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:587-594 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` only accepts positive integers, so `0` cannot be used as a disable sentinel.
  WHY: reviewers disagreed on intent, but the observable effect is that setting 0 does not disable the timeout and the default 1080 seconds is used instead.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1029-1148 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: jq is invoked without checking that it exists.
  WHY: one reviewer rejected this as unnecessary because prerequisite validation covers jq, but the others flagged the missing guard as a low-confidence robustness gap.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:140-148 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: there is no torn-chain detection when `parts_by_manifest` contains partial slots from interleaved older writes.
  WHY: the lone reviewer said a newer torn write can fall back to V1 without warning; no other review contradicted this.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:284 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `orchestrate_state_v2.py` is missing from the staged support-script allowlist.
  WHY: the staging loop copies scripts by explicit name, and the V2 helper is not included, so the pack/extract calls fail in consumer repos.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1060-1076 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment()` returns 0 on all V2 failure paths.
  WHY: the pack-failure, zero-chunk, and chunk-post failure branches all log errors but return success, so callers cannot detect persistence failure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1058-1060 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: stderr is merged into the JSON manifest capture with `2>&1`.
  WHY: this is currently a hardening concern, but future stderr on a success path could corrupt `manifest_json` and break downstream parsing.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:147-158, 2891-2901 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: the timeline API lookup is not wrapped in `gh_retry`.
  WHY: the direct `gh api` calls lose transient-failure resilience and can widen the race window before `gh pr create`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1039-1081 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment()` has no V1 fallback on V2 failure and silently degrades from the old behavior.
  WHY: when V2 packing fails, the function gives up instead of attempting the previous V1 single-comment write, so small-state projects on consumer repos can stop persisting state entirely.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: the staged scripts do not include the helper, so `python3 scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py pack/extract` fails in consumer repos.

  WHY: both explicit script-copy loops omit the new helper, so the V2 paths fail at runtime in consumer repos.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1057-1059 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: stderr from the pack helper is merged into the JSON manifest capture.
  WHY: mixed stderr/stdout can break the manifest JSON and send execution into the zero-chunk failure path even when packing succeeded.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:148-159 | severity=medium | confidence=3

  WHY: the direct `gh api` call is less resilient to transient GitHub failures, even though the step is intentionally fail-open.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:587-594 | severity=low | confidence=2

  WHY: if an operator wants `0` as a disable sentinel, the code does not honor it and uses the default instead.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1096-1097, 1138-1148 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: jq is invoked without checking availability.
  WHY: the helper and manifest parsing assume jq exists; that is a defensive gap if the runner or environment is minimal or misconfigured.
